concerns.location: tasks.md:Note on FR-012 and FR-013 vs spec.md:FR-012, FR-013
concerns.text: Tasks doc unilaterally declares FR-012 (Reference-Validator at three points) and FR-013 (artifact hashes in state/) 'platform-owned and intentionally not tasked'. These are spec MUSTs; retroactive narrowing in the tasks doc without amending the spec weakens requirements. Either amend spec/plan to formally delegate, or restore tasks covering them.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003, T006 vs contracts/output.schema.yaml and data-model.md
concerns.text: T003 writes per-subject rows to metrics.csv, but output.schema.yaml has additionalProperties:false, no subject_id field, and requires cohort-level fields (t_statistic, p_value_fdr, cohen_d, significant, benchmark_reference, validation_type) on every row. T006's contract tests against this schema will fail on T003's Phase-1 output. The schema/data-model/tasks are mutually inconsistent; FR-014/FR-015 cannot be satisfied as tasked.

FR-011/SC-001 define noise floor as the standard deviation of the pre-stimulus baseline; T003 says 'SD/SEM of the -200 to 0 ms pre-stimulus baseline' and the output schema's snr_ratio says SEM. SD vs SEM yield different SNR values, so the SNR >= 3.0 validity criterion is not consistently measurable — a semantic weakening of FR-011.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 et al. vs constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI keys its justification clause to 'the specific OpenNeuro ds000246 or PhysioNet dataset instance used', while all tasks use ds004510. The constitution must be amended (or dataset reconciled) so tasks are not silently violating a ratified principle.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Task format and paths vs plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: Tasks write outputs to data/results/metrics.csv, data/results/stats.json, data/results/figures/ while plan.md's structure places them at results/. The divergence breaks the plan's declared layout and any consumer (T006 tests, T009 handoff) keyed to it. Align one path convention.

Plan Task 5.2 validates stats.json against contracts/stats.schema.yaml (listed in plan structure but not provided); T006 validates stats.json against output.schema.yaml. The target schema for stats.json is ambiguous — pick one and update both docs.

Spec's ICA acceptance scenario specifies a concrete criterion ('explaining >99% variance'); T002 only says 'reject EOG/ECG-correlated components' with no threshold, leaving the acceptance scenario unverifiable. State the criterion or amend the spec.
